# Hawley Construction Co.
> Premier home remodeling and construction contractor serving Tampa Bay, Florida

## About
Hawley Construction Co. is a licensed and insured home remodeling contractor based in St. Petersburg, Florida, serving the entire Tampa Bay area including Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, and Manatee counties. The company is led by owner Landon Hawley and specializes in high-quality residential remodeling and construction projects. Founded with a commitment to craftsmanship, transparent pricing, and clear communication, Hawley Construction has completed 100+ remodeling projects across the Tampa Bay region.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Tampa Bay?
A kitchen remodel in Tampa Bay costs between $25,000 and $85,000 depending on scope and materials. A minor refresh (new countertops, cabinet refacing, updated fixtures) ranges from $15,000–$30,000. A mid-range remodel with new cabinets, quartz countertops, and appliances costs $35,000–$55,000. A full custom kitchen renovation with structural changes, custom cabinetry, and premium finishes ranges from $60,000–$100,000+. Hawley Construction provides free detailed estimates for all projects.

### How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Tampa?
Bathroom remodeling in the Tampa Bay area costs between $12,000 and $50,000. A basic refresh (new vanity, fixtures, paint) starts at $8,000–$15,000. A standard remodel with new tile, shower, and fixtures costs $18,000–$35,000. A luxury master bathroom with walk-in shower, freestanding tub, heated floors, and custom tile ranges from $35,000–$60,000+.

### How much does a Trex deck cost in Florida?
A Trex composite deck in Florida costs between $45–$85 per square foot installed, depending on the Trex line chosen (Select, Enhance, or Transcend) and deck complexity. A standard 300 sq ft Trex deck costs $13,500–$25,500 installed. Multi-level decks, built-in seating, and custom railings increase the cost. Trex decks last 25+ years with no staining or sealing required.

### How much does a home addition cost in Tampa?
Home additions in Tampa cost between $150–$350 per square foot depending on the type. A standard room addition (bedroom, family room) costs $150–$250/sq ft. A kitchen or bathroom addition costs $200–$350/sq ft due to plumbing and fixtures. A 400 sq ft addition typically ranges from $60,000–$140,000 total including permits, foundation, framing, and finishes.

### How much does a sunroom cost in Florida?
A sunroom addition in Florida costs between $25,000 and $80,000 depending on size and type. A three-season sunroom (screened, not climate-controlled) costs $15,000–$35,000. A four-season sunroom with insulated glass, HVAC, and electrical costs $40,000–$80,000. Sunrooms add significant value to Florida homes due to year-round usability.

### How long does a kitchen remodel take?
A kitchen remodel takes 6–12 weeks from demolition to completion. The timeline breaks down as: design and material selection (2–4 weeks), permits (1–2 weeks), demolition and rough work (1–2 weeks), cabinetry and countertop installation (2–3 weeks), and finishing (1–2 weeks). Custom cabinetry may add 4–6 weeks of lead time.

### How long does a bathroom remodel take?
A standard bathroom remodel takes 3–6 weeks. A half-bath refresh can be completed in 2–3 weeks. A full master bathroom renovation with custom tile, walk-in shower, and new plumbing takes 5–8 weeks.

### Why choose Trex decking over wood in Florida?
Trex composite decking outperforms wood in Florida because: (1) It resists moisture, mold, and rot — critical in Florida's humidity. (2) It won't warp, crack, or splinter like pressure-treated wood. (3) It requires zero staining, sealing, or painting. (4) It resists UV fading with a 25-year warranty. (5) It's made from 95% recycled materials. Wood decks in Florida typically need replacement every 8–12 years; Trex lasts 25+ years.

### What countertop materials are best for Florida kitchens?
For Florida kitchens, quartz countertops (Cambria, Caesarstone, Silestone) are the top choice due to durability, stain resistance, and zero maintenance. Granite remains popular for natural beauty. Quartzite offers the look of marble with superior durability. Marble is not recommended for high-use kitchens due to etching and staining in Florida's humid climate.

### Do I need a permit for remodeling in Tampa Bay?
Yes, most remodeling projects in Tampa Bay require a building permit. Kitchen and bathroom remodels involving plumbing, electrical, or structural changes require permits. Home additions, deck construction, and sunrooms all require permits. Hawley Construction handles all permit applications and inspections as part of our service.

### What areas does Hawley Construction serve?
Hawley Construction serves the entire Tampa Bay metropolitan area including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Wesley Chapel, Largo, Dunedin, Safety Harbor, Palm Harbor, Tarpon Springs, Oldsmar, Riverview, and surrounding communities in Hillsborough and Pinellas counties.

Yes, Hawley Construction is fully licensed as a General Contractor in the state of Florida, bonded, and carries comprehensive liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage.
